content.english: [I], the poor person, who spread out [my] hands to you –
Find [me] favorable, and forgive [my] sin.
[I] come in the merit of [my] ancestors, and put trust in you;
[My ancestors are] the Ezraḥ [Abraham], who shone like shining light,
And the merit of the beloved one [Isaac], who was bound upon the altar.
The Ezraḥ, who shone like shining light,
And the merit of the beloved one, who was bound upon the altar.
After Sarah had withered, and her moisture had dried up,
She gave birth to a flowering sapling of Abraham.
He was circumcised, and his [sacrificial-like] aroma ascended on the eighth day,
His fragrance was like perfume, made by a perfumer.
His merit – on behalf of the people that are weeping and moaning,
Remember it! And direct your kindness to them;
Please do not punish them angrily!
The Ezraḥ, who shone like shining light,
And the merit of the beloved one, who was bound upon the altar.
Facing your [Torah’s] ark, your people prostrates,
Concerned about their sin, and bitterly cries,
But, while fleeing from you, O my Rock, they go towards you,
Cleansing their filth [literally: blood] in your rescuing waters.

content.hebrew: Ki at levad shomer emet poḳeyaḥ
content.transliteration: כִּי אַתְּ לְבַד שֹׁמֵר אֱמֶת פֹּקֵחַ
content.english: For you alone are the guardian of truth, and giver of sight
To the blind, and you close and you open.
(Please, remember to have mercy for the people that trusts [you]!)
The Ezraḥ, who shone like shining light,
And the merit of the beloved one, who was bound upon the altar.
[Ishmael], the son of the handmaiden, approached [Isaac], and, as if already victorious,
Praised and glorified himself, vainly puffing:

content.transliteration: נָם בֶּן שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה בְּיוֹם קֹדֵחַ
content.english: He said: “When I was thirteen, on a blazing hot day,
I was circumcised, and I did not get up to protest.
I have great merit, that [my body] was smoothed out,
That my foreskin was rolled off on a burning hot day,
And the pain, the arrow of my pain, shot through me.”
The Ezraḥ, who shone like shining light,
And the merit of the beloved one, who was bound upon the altar.
Responding to him with goodness, victoriously,

content.hebrew: Yitsḥaḳ, venam lo, el zevul moteyaḥ
content.transliteration: יִצְחָק, וְנָם לוֹ, אֵל זְבוּל מֹתֵחַ
content.english: Isaac said to him: “If God, who stretches out the heavens,
Would speak [and command me thus], I would sacrifice myself for him.
But you, O wild ass, he has sent away,
And already set you loose from your chains as a wild donkey!

content.transliteration: כָּל מוּם בְּךָ עִוֵּר וְגַם פִּסֵּחַ
content.english: You have all kinds of blemishes in you – blindness and lameness;
It is not for you to take a part in God’s inheritance.”
The Ezraḥ, who shone like shining light,
And the merit of the beloved one, who was bound upon the altar.
